author: Dubzzy__
body:
Hello, I am Alpha_Creepers, and I was very concerned about something that happened to me this morning, Sunday, May 3,2015 (Philippine Time).

While I was playing on the map called Embers 1, I suddenly started to lag, shortly after the lag, I was "kicked" out of the server. Me, being used to it, thought that it was just poor connection. I tried to join again, but this time, a very surprising message came up.

The message stated that i was banned by MLGPorky for "hacking-auto shift/flying" which Im pretty sure of that I did not do.

As soon as i saw this message, I immediately went on the avicus forums on my phone and started to write a letter regarding this.
But, another bug that came out as soon as I was sending the message, was that a syntax was shown saying that I should report the bug immediately to admins.

Anyway, thats besides the point, what i really want to emphasize on is the fact that I was banned for reasons I did not do. If you don't believe me, I would be glad to show you my MC files and what have you just to prove that I do not have such "hacks".

I love Avicus enough for me to avoid doing things I knew that would give me sanctions. Avicus is literally my MC life, though i may not be as good as you admins, mods, and other staff members, I'm pretty sure that I love Avicus as much as you guys do.

Please, just please, fix this bug and urban me. If I did something wrong please just give me another chance, and tell me what my mistake is. I believe that this ban of mine was an error because i know deep inside and my whole self outside, that I love avicus and i will never do things to destroy my love for it.

Sincerely, 
Alpha_Creepers
